newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent ends higher ahead of Christmas close.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent ends higher ahead of Christmas close.

text.p: IPE Brent crude and gas oil futures closed slightly higher on Tuesday in an extremely quiet half-day trading session.
"There's hardly anyone here. It's very quiet," one trader said.
February Brent closed 20 cents higher at $23.39 a barrel while January gas oil wiped out Monday's $3.50 loss to close $4 higher at $215.50 a tonne.
"Gas oil's firmed up a bit," said a second trader. "And that's helped the market higher."
Traders said forecasts for cold weather in the Northeast United States -- the world's key heating oil market -- had helped push both complexes higher.
Independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said temperatures would be below normal from Wednesday to Friday.
The IPE will be shut on Wednesday and Thursday. It will reopen on Friday for a shortened trading session ending at 1730 GMT.
